qualificationGaps: The existing socket isolation tests use a simulated per-connection stall; they do not prove actual native runtime scheduling under the observed production stall.
Synthetic native checks and total unit-test counts did not cover a loaded production runtime with concurrent optional work and slow history.
Historic request logs do not preserve stage durations sufficient to distinguish preflight wait, native submission and delayed acknowledgement for every slow send.

releaseDecision.reason: Do not replace the active runtime or discard provider support on a temporal correlation. Preserve194 as the comparison baseline; demonstrate the failure and correction on the same workload before another repair claim.
requiredEvidence: Compare baseline194 and candidate on the same bounded slow-history/send workload.
Retain original outgoing identity and validate acknowledgement independently of transcript refresh.
Qualify actual native request timing with background activity; do not substitute independent quick metadata reads for send timing.
Complete current-source native visible-transcript recovery and exact signed APK review before publication.
